title: Gephi
description: An open-source desktop application to visually analyze networks.

title: Gephi Lite
description: The online version of Gephi. Lighter and simpler, it does not require installation.

title: igraph
description: A collection of network analysis tools with the emphasis on efficiency, portability and ease of use. Open source and free, igraph can be used in R, python, Mathematica, and C/C++

title: NetworkX
description: A Python package for the creation, manipulation, and study of the structure, dynamics, and functions of complex networks.
